review.contents: Single-panel INHα immunohistochemistry micrograph of canine ovary tissue (positive-control style image) with a 500 µm scale bar; no tumor tissue and no tabulated values.
review.clinical_relevance_notes: Antibody reference image listed in the article as Figure S1, supporting that the tumor stromal cells were INHα negative; it is control tissue and carries no individual animal data.
limitations: Ownership unresolved: the image shows ovary control tissue, which the article does not attribute to any of the six dogs; the filename number is not literal ownership evidence.

visual.general_description: Brown immunostained tissue section with many round and oval brown-rimmed follicle-like structures of different sizes in lavender stroma, and a scale bar.
visual.detailed_description: A 1432 by 816 pixel bright-field micrograph. Lavender-pink stroma with small purple nuclei fills the field. Within it lie many round, oval or irregular structures of very different sizes, each with a strong brown (chromogen) rim or filling: several very large pale cavities lined by a brown band, a medium round mass densely brown at the lower left, and numerous small round or elongated brown structures at the centre and right. A black bar at the lower left carries the white printed text "500 µm". No other printed text, label or arrow is present.
